title: Transfer a vessel registration due to the death of the registered operator
summary: You can transfer a vessel registration to another person if the original registered operator has passed away, by visiting a service centre.
intro: If you need to transfer a vessel registration to another person because the vessel owner is deceased, you can do this at a service centre.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for Transfer of Vessel Registration'
Additional documents depending on whether there is a will or not:
A copy of the relevant section of the will or probate document,
Signed, written advice from a solicitor or NSW Trustee and Guardian.
If the beneficiary is listed in the will, the new operator must provide a letter signed by all other beneficiaries outlining their agreement to the transfer.
If the executor, a document signed by all the executors authorising the transfer of registration, unless the will states the executors can act jointly and severally.

If the beneficiary/executor is transferring, a copy of the relevant section of the will or probate document and a letter, signed by both parties, outlining the agreement between the beneficiary/executor and the surviving joint operator.
Signed, written advice from a solicitor including details of the agreement.
A copy of the Letters of Administration, issued by the Supreme Court (if available).
A Statutory declaration completed by the administrator stating they are the appointed administrator of the estate (if transferring to next of kin).
Their relationship with the deceased (for example, spouse, sibling, child).
A declaration that to their knowledge there is no administrator for the estate.
A declaration that to their knowledge there is no will.
A declaration of the reason they are entitled to transfer the registration into their name.
A declaration that there is no other closer relative who would be given preference or is entitled to the registration (if transferring to next of kin).
If there is a will, one of the following documents naming the new operator as the beneficiary or executor.
If there is more than one person involved, one of the following documents.

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit your application.

faqs.q: Where can I transfer the vessel registration?
faqs.a: You must visit a service centre to transfer the vessel registration.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to transfer the registration?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, the 'Application for Transfer of Vessel Registration' form, and additional documents depending on whether there is a will or not.
It means that any one of the executors can sign a document without the signature of the other(s).
